metadata.description: ACE-style comprehensive playbook for MAP Framework development

ARCHITECTURE_PATTERNS.description: Proven architectural decisions and design patterns for system structure

IMPLEMENTATION_PATTERNS.description: Code patterns and idioms for common development tasks

SECURITY_PATTERNS.description: Security best practices, authentication, authorization, and vulnerability prevention

PERFORMANCE_PATTERNS.description: Optimization techniques, caching strategies, and performance anti-patterns to avoid

ERROR_PATTERNS.description: Common errors, their root causes, and proven solutions

TESTING_STRATEGIES.description: Test patterns, mocking approaches, and coverage strategies

CODE_QUALITY_RULES.description: Style guides, naming conventions, and maintainability principles

TOOL_USAGE.description: Proper usage of libraries, frameworks, APIs, and development tools

DEBUGGING_TECHNIQUES.description: Troubleshooting workflows, diagnostic approaches, and debugging tools

bullet_schema.description: Schema for each bullet in the playbook

example.content: Detailed pattern description with context and rationale (minimum 100 characters)
example.code_example:
```python
# Code demonstrating the pattern
import jwt
token = jwt.decode(token, secret, algorithms=['HS256'], verify=True)
```

usage_instructions.for_actor: Load relevant bullets via PlaybookManager.get_relevant_bullets(query). Use patterns in implementation. Track used bullet_ids in output.
usage_instructions.for_reflector: Analyze which bullets were helpful/harmful. Suggest new bullets for missing patterns. Tag bullets based on effectiveness.
usage_instructions.for_curator: Apply delta operations from Reflector insights. Add new bullets, update counters, deprecate harmful patterns. Run deduplication.
usage_instructions.for_orchestrator: Load playbook before Actor invocation. Pass relevant bullets as context. Trigger Reflector+Curator after each subtask completion.

maintenance.cleanup_schedule: Monthly review of deprecated bullets with harmful_count >= deprecation_threshold
